conservative_decisions.decision: arms A/E/F/G/H/I are taken verbatim from the extractor registry, which was fixed before any content value existed
conservative_decisions.reason: ARM I is A plus all six metrics by pre-registration, never a subset selected after reading E--H

conservative_decisions.decision: undefined content metrics stay NaN and use XGBoost's native missing branch inside an arm
conservative_decisions.reason: imputation, a fitted fill value or an extra indicator inside an arm would widen the registered budget

conservative_decisions.decision: the presence indicators appear only in two declared diagnostics, never in an arm, and take part in no ranking
conservative_decisions.reason: presence of the header-template metric is exactly service==http, which P1 forbids as a feature; the diagnostics bound that contribution instead of hiding it

conservative_decisions.decision: ARM A must reproduce the published baseline score stream byte-for-byte before any artifact is written
conservative_decisions.reason: without that identity the six-arm comparison would not be anchored to the ratified 13/40 reference

conservative_decisions.decision: no tuning, no validation split, no early stopping, no rebalancing and no threshold search
conservative_decisions.reason: only the feature budget varies; thresholds come from training negatives at 1% and 0.1% exactly as ratified

content_feature_definitions.destination_non_printable_ratio: same byte-weighted ratio for destination payload
content_feature_definitions.destination_payload_entropy_normalized: same normalized per-flow Shannon mean for destination payload
content_feature_definitions.normalized_header_template_repeat_ratio: 1 - distinct normalized HTTP request templates / requests, where a template contains only bounded method class, version class and ordered header names; URI, host and all values are discarded before hashing
content_feature_definitions.payload_prefix_repeat_ratio: 1 - distinct SHA-256 fingerprints of the first up-to-64 source payload bytes / source-payload-bearing flows; fingerprints never leave Zeek memory
content_feature_definitions.source_non_printable_ratio: source payload bytes outside ASCII 0x20-0x7e and TAB/CR/LF divided by all source payload bytes
content_feature_definitions.source_payload_entropy_normalized: mean over source-payload-bearing flows of Shannon bits/byte divided by log2(min(256, payload_bytes)); undefined for windows without a qualifying flow

missingness_confound.finding: presence of normalized_header_template_repeat_ratio is exactly equivalent to service == http (12,279 frozen windows, all http)
missingness_confound.treatment: the six arms were run exactly as pre-registered; two declared diagnostics replace the values with presence indicators to bound the contribution, and a RETAIN verdict additionally requires that the indicator alone does not reproduce the gain
missingness_confound.why_it_matters: P1 forbids entity_service as a feature and XGBoost branches natively on missing values, so an ARM H or ARM I effect could be carried by missingness rather than by header-template repetition

question: do the six first-wave payload-content aggregates improve botnet/ares episode detection beyond distinct_payload_ratio alone, under the frozen P1 protocol?

r11.demonstrates: within-protocol transfer to held-out Ares windows and marginal feature-budget differences on the same episodes
r11.does_not_demonstrate: generalisation to other victims, attackers, captures, botnet families, or operational streaming latency

threshold_rule: training negatives only at 1% and 0.1%; no test observation selects a threshold
